task: Add a signature_backfill CLI that writes committed real semantic signatures into live findings (filling empty signatureTags with signatureTagSource='backfill'), keeping every finding _hash byte-identical.
outcome:
Running `node bin/lattice.js signature_backfill --map <file>` dry-runs by default and prints a report, e.g.:
  signature_backfill (DRY-RUN): scanned 695, would fill 660, skip 22 (confirmed), skip 13 (no mapping)
    by-source after apply: backfill 660, confirmed 22, auto 13
  (dry-run -- nothing written; pass --apply to persist)
With --apply it writes signatureTag + signatureTagSource='backfill' onto the empty-tag findings via store.writeFindings; re-running is a no-op (idempotent); confirmed tags are never overwritten; every touched finding's _hash is unchanged. Afterwards (post-DONE operation) learning_scan derives real signals and learning_effectiveness reports non-zero predictive value.
facts: finding_add attaches signatureTag + signatureTagSource AFTER the finding _hash (finding.ts ~line 312); both are EXCLUDED from signFinding / the _hash (B-4f46 + 3.2). This story must reuse that exact attach pattern so writes never change any _hash.
SignatureTagSource = 'auto' | 'confirmed' (experience-layer-types.ts:81); this story adds 'backfill' (used on core/types.ts Finding.signatureTagSource).
store.writeFindings(storyId, data) is the findings write port; store.readFindings + listStoryIds enumerate.

The signature map is the committed 3.5 artifact (lattice-Paper/backfill_signatures.json, { findingId -> 'area|failureMode' }); the command consumes it via --map and never calls an LLM at runtime (deterministic, auditable).

Adding a new command requires a PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry or the process-fact-contract suite fails; this is a WRITING L2 command (not read-only, not in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS), like signature_registry_set.
constraints: Every touched finding's _hash MUST be byte-identical after the write (the single most important safety property; verifier-enforced).
Only fill EMPTY signatureTags; never overwrite 'confirmed'; overwrite 'auto' only with --overwriteAuto.
Dry-run is the DEFAULT; --apply required to write; idempotent.
The pure decision leaf does no I/O; the handler does the store reads/writes.
No LLM at runtime; no change to signFinding/_hash/any gate; mass-apply against live findings is a post-DONE operation, not part of this story's diff.
unknowns: Default --map path -- resolved: require explicit --map (no silent default writing to live data); the smoke uses a temp map.
Whether to also persist the map into the repo -- resolved: out of scope; the map lives in lattice-Paper and is passed via --map at apply time.
